items.title: Define story scope contract data model and persistence
items.context: Add a minimal story-scoped ScopeContract model for allowedModify, allowedCreate, allowedTest, protectedFiles, explicitExcludes, mode, and scopeChangeReason. Persist through Koala commands, not direct story JSON edits.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `koala scope_contract_show --storyId=B-be27` 时看到 `Scope contract: configured`，并列出 `mode`, `allowedModify`, `allowedCreate`, `allowedTest`, `protectedFiles`, `explicitExcludes`。

happy.desc: A saved scope contract can be read back with all fields preserved.

edge.desc: Missing optional arrays default to empty arrays and do not crash show/check commands.

adversarial.desc: Invalid mode or malformed path entries are rejected before persistence.

items.title: Add CLI commands to create, show, update, and check scope contracts
items.context: Expose a mechanical entrypoint such as scope_contract_set/show/check. The check command must compare git diff against the contract and return structured pass/warn/fail output.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `koala scope_contract_check --storyId=B-be27 --json` 时看到 `status: pass|warn|fail`、`violations` 文件清单和每条违规对应的 contract rule。

happy.desc: scope_contract_set/show/check CLI commands exist and return structured output for an in-scope diff.

edge.desc: scope_contract_check handles a clean worktree and reports no changed files without failing.

adversarial.desc: scope_contract_check returns fail with violating paths when git diff includes protected or excluded files.

items.title: Integrate post-diff scope gate into lifecycle prechecks
items.context: Wire scope checking into REVIEW, TEST, and DONE gate flow without blocking old stories that lack contracts unless strict mode or story policy requires it. Include local/shadow/enforce behavior to avoid false blocks.
items.userSees: 当 story 进入 REVIEW/TEST/DONE 时，终端会显示 `Scope gate: pass`；若有越界文件则显示 `Scope gate: fail` 和阻塞原因。shadow 模式显示 `Scope gate: warn`。

happy.desc: A story with an enforce contract and only allowed changed files can advance through the scope gate.

edge.desc: Stories without a contract stay backward-compatible unless strict policy explicitly requires one.

adversarial.desc: An enforce-mode contract blocks REVIEW/TEST/DONE when the diff contains a protected or excluded path.

items.title: Support explicit scope change acknowledgement and reviewer-visible evidence
items.context: If implementation needs to touch an out-of-scope file, require an explicit reason and make the change visible to reviewers instead of silently expanding scope.
items.userSees: 越界需要升级时，用户会看到 `Scope change acknowledged`，其中包含 `reason`, `addedPaths`, `actor`, `timestamp`；reviewer 也能在 story_review/status 输出里看到该记录。

happy.desc: An explicit scope change acknowledgement records actor, reason, timestamp, and added paths.

edge.desc: A scope acknowledgement with an empty or too-short reason is rejected.

adversarial.desc: Acknowledgement cannot silently hide an out-of-scope diff; reviewer-visible output still lists the expanded paths.

items.title: Add regression tests for allowed, blocked, and acknowledged scope changes
items.context: Add focused tests that prove allowed paths pass, protected/excluded paths fail in enforce mode, shadow mode warns, and acknowledged scope expansion is visible in validation output. Include package build or targeted smoke test commands as verification evidence.
items.userSees: 用户运行 `npm --prefix packages/main run test:scope-contract-smoke` 和 `koala validate --story=B-be27 --json` 时看到 scope contract 的 allowed、blocked、shadow、acknowledged cases 全部 pass。

happy.desc: The smoke test passes for allowed changed files and clean worktree cases.

edge.desc: The smoke test proves shadow mode warns without blocking and missing contracts stay compatible where intended.

adversarial.desc: The smoke test proves enforce mode fails for protected/excluded files and requires explicit acknowledgement for expansion.
